description: This file defines API endpoints for managing tests and submissions in a testing platform, including schemas, route handlers, and logic for creating, retrieving, and evaluating tests and submissions.

classes.name: QuestionSchema
classes.description: Schema for question data within tests

classes.name: TestsListResource
classes.description: API resource for listing and creating tests

classes.name: TestItemResource
classes.description: API resource for retrieving a specific test

classes.name: TestSubmissionsResource
classes.description: API resource for creating submissions for a test

classes.name: TestEvaluateResource
classes.description: API resource for evaluating submissions of a test

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve list of tests or a specific test

methods.name: post
methods.description: Create a new test, submission, or evaluate submissions
